scope: Durable content-addressed evidence sealing (blobs/sha256 before atomic manifests) with hash-mismatch abort, orphan recovery, idempotent ACK-loss replay, quota/disk-full rejection, and sealed-byte immutability

commands.output: Validated 40 detailed tasks, resources, references and progress; no runtime capability inferred.
Passed all 11 tests in cmd/breachatlas and all 18 test suites in tests (including C05, C06, C07, C08, and C09 sealing/orphan-recovery suites).
Plan validation, TypeScript check, Vite build, and 29 web/contract tests passed.
VALIDATION PASSED: Checked repository JSON files and contract invariants.

observations: SealStore.SealQuarantined in internal/evidence/seal.go streams and re-hashes quarantined bytes into staging/*.blob.tmp, fsyncs, and promotes atomically to blobs/sha256/<sha256> before writing manifests/<case_id>/<evidence_id>.manifest.json and seal-index.json.
Any SHA-256 or byte-size mismatch aborts cleanly with ErrDigestMismatch / ErrSizeMismatch before blob promotion or manifest sealing.

Interrupting writer at the staged-byte/manifest boundary (FailAfterBlobSyncBeforeManifest) leaves prior authoritative state intact across restart and allows RecoverOrphans to report and reclaim unreferenced orphan blobs cleanly.

Replaying committed OperationID handles lost ACKs idempotently with IdempotentReplay=true and zero duplicate side effects; conflicting parameters fail with ErrOperationConflict, excessive retry attempts fail with ErrRetryLimitExceeded, and disk-full/quota checks fail closed.
Sealed blobs and manifests are never overwritten (ErrSealedBytesImmutable), and OpenSealStore enforces single-writer flock exclusivity.

observed_limitations: Post-seal byte verification against signed/committed manifests belongs to C10 (internal/evidence/verify.go).
rollback_or_recovery_observation: Revert internal/evidence/seal.go, tests/seal_test.go, and C09 fixtures/evidence. No database schemas, migrations, .env files, or Dockerfiles were modified.
